newsitem.title: UK: BAA makes agreed 406 mln stg bid for DFI.
newsitem.headline: BAA makes agreed 406 mln stg bid for DFI.

text.p: British airports operator BAA Plc said on Thursday it had made an agreed offer for U.S. company Duty Free International Inc, valuing it at 406 million stg.
BAA is making a tender offer of $24 per share in DFI, which will makes it the second biggest duty and tax free business in the world.

"By acquiring another large business unaffected by the possible loss of European duty free, we will be able to protect and enhance profits, bring improved merchandising to DFI, build on a range of synergies, and further develop the business through a growing number of international airports," said BAA's chief executive John Egan.
DFI had sales of 343 million stg last year and pretax profits of 20.5 million.
